title: Revised MD17 dataset (rMD17)
citation: Christensen, Anders S.; Von lilienfeld, Anatole (2020). Revised MD17 dataset (rMD17). figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.12672038.v4
